title: 2000 AMC 12 Problem 10
statement: The point \(P = (1, 2, 3)\) is reflected in the \(xy\)-plane, then its image \(Q\) is rotated by \(180^\circ\) about the \(x\)-axis to produce \(R,\) and finally, \(R\) is translated by \(5\) units in the positive \(y\) direction to produce \(S.\) What are the coordinates of \(S?\)

solutions.text:
Reflecting \((1, 2, 3)\) in the \(xy\)-plane gives \(Q = (1, 2, -3).\)

Rotating \(180^\circ\) about the \(x\)-axis negates \(y\) and \(z,\) giving \(R = (1, -2, 3).\)

Translating \(5\) units in the positive \(y\) direction gives \(S = (1, 3, 3).\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: A \(180^\circ\) turn about the \(x\)-axis negates both the \(y\)- and \(z\)-coordinates
